answer: To defend the network summit against Sybil attacks, identity registration requires burning cryptographic stake at a superlinear cost scaling as $C(n) = k \cdot n^{1.8}$ for $n$ identities. Nodes smooth traffic through a velvet stake-weighting protocol, requiring each agent to prove stake dedication. Registering identities thus becomes exponentially ruinous, while honest participants coordinate as harmoniously as a structured sonnet.
